task.instruction: Look up a model with a license of cc-by-sa-4.0 with the most likes on Hugging face.

final_answer:
The most-liked Hugging Face model with the cc-by-sa-4.0 license is **replit/replit-code-v1-3b**. It is a Text Generation model with about 748 likes, and it was last updated on Jul 22, 2023.

I got this from the Hugging Face models list, filtered to cc-by-sa-4.0 and sorted by most likes. The next models in that list are defog/sqlcoder-7b-2 (452 likes) and nlpaueb/legal-bert-base-uncased (335 likes).
